instruction:
In `sanctuary/core/cognitive_cycle.py`, `CognitiveCycle._cycle()` calls `self.model.consolidate()` synchronously during NREM sleep. Living-weight consolidation can take a while, and running it on the event-loop thread stalls the 10 Hz cognitive loop for that whole time.

Run consolidation on a worker thread instead, so the event loop stays free. It's safe: `consolidate()` already takes the shared model lock internally. Keep the existing behavior otherwise. It runs only during NREM and only if the model has `consolidate`, and an error is logged as non-fatal.
pytest_args: not benchmark and not integration and not property

source.subject: fix: Phase 3 W1 — offload NREM consolidate() off the loop thread (audit item 12)
